integrity: Finite complete generation of 30 facets from 720 vertex filtrations and independent gap/root description, exact binary-boundary ranks, signed fixed-face enumeration on 163 faces; standalone dependency-free Python checker. Full scientific conclusions are stated with explicit quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Single finite cycle, rational homology representation only; not a classification of integral equivariant lattices or equivariant homotopy types, nor an all-length theorem. Novelty checks cannot rule out unpublished or unindexed equivalent work.
title: The six-cycle strong-Morse homology representation factors through triangle symmetries
